Package com.hkust.marketplace.utils

Class ReviewService

java.lang.Object
com.hkust.marketplace.utils.ReviewService
public final class ReviewService extends Object
Manage Reviews (SRS UC-1.9) and Report Listing (UC-1.10) from the buyer's side. Each method checks the buyer, validates the input before anything changes, saves through the stores and notifies the other side in the same transaction.

  • Method Details

    • reviewableDeals

      public List<Deal> reviewableDeals(User actor)
      Step 2: the buyer's finished deals that have no review yet, most recently finished first.

    • submitReview

      public Review submitReview(User actor, Deal deal, int rating, String text)
      Step 3.1: stores a 1-5 star review of the deal's seller and notifies the seller; the seller's average rating is derived from the stored reviews, so it updates at once.
      Throws:
      SecurityException - if actor is not the deal's active buyer
      IllegalStateException - with NOT_ELIGIBLE if the deal is not finished or already reviewed (A1)
      IllegalArgumentException - with RATING_MISSING or TEXT_MISSING (A2)

    • myReviews

      public List<Review> myReviews(User actor)
      Step 3.2: every review the buyer has submitted, newest first, with any seller reply.

    • listingOf

      public Listing listingOf(Review review)
      The listing a review is about, resolved through its completed deal, or null if unknown.

    • flagReview

      public void flagReview(User actor, Review review, boolean flagged)
      Seller flags (or unflags) a review they received, so the admin sees it first (SRS UC-3.8). The review stays visible and keeps counting towards the seller's rating until the admin hides it.

    • reportListing

      public ListingReport reportListing(User actor, Listing listing, String reason)
      Report Listing (UC-1.10): stores an Open report and notifies every admin.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - with REASON_MISSING if the reason is empty (A1)
